plain: Our card's yearly interest rate is 19.99% and can change over time. That's lower than the average across the country, and you won't pay a fee each year to have the card.
alt: With a variable APR of just 19.99%, below the national average, and no annual fee, our card keeps more money in your pocket.
frame_flip: Don't overpay: our card's variable APR of 19.99% saves you from the higher national average, and you'll never lose money to an annual fee.
reordered: There's no annual fee on our card, and its variable APR of 19.99% is lower than the national average.
